data_description.dataset_name: JPL ARIA Sentinel-1 InSAR line-of-sight displacement time series
data_description.data_type: Interferometric SAR line-of-sight surface-displacement time-series observations
data_description.data_format: JPL ARIA processed InSAR raster time series with spatial metadata

spatial_coverage.coverage: Tulare Basin scenes covered by the selected JPL ARIA Sentinel-1 InSAR product.

data_description.temporal_unit: InSAR acquisition interval; preserve acquisition dates and reference geometry.
analytical_capabilities: Remove long-term compaction from LOS displacement time series
Aggregate or align displacement observations to monthly hydrological support
Analyse short-term surface deformation associated with hydrological variation

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Line-of-sight surface displacement, typically metres or millimetres according to ARIA product metadata.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use processed JPL ARIA InSAR displacement products. Do not substitute Sentinel-1 GRD backscatter; GRD does not supply interferometric phase-derived LOS displacement.

data_description.data_format: CSR RL06 Mascon gridded monthly solution

spatial_coverage.coverage: Basin-scale aggregation of the global CSR RL06 Mascon solution.

analytical_capabilities: Aggregate monthly equivalent-water-height or terrestrial-water-storage anomalies over Tulare Basin
Align basin-scale mass-storage anomalies with InSAR displacement observations
Analyse co-variation between short-term deformation and water-storage change

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Monthly terrestrial-water-storage anomaly or equivalent water height, according to CSR RL06 Mascon metadata.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use CSR RL06 Mascon solutions and their documented corrections and scaling guidance. Do not substitute the deprecated GEE NASA/GRACE/MASS_GRIDS/LAND product.

combination_contract.physical_object: Tulare Basin hydrological variation observed jointly through ARIA InSAR deformation and CSR RL06 Mascon storage anomalies
combination_contract.alignment: Aggregate CSR monthly storage anomalies over Tulare Basin and align them with ARIA displacement dates or compatible monthly aggregates; preserve the different spatial supports.
combination_contract.supplement_policy: Additional data may provide context or validation but cannot replace either required product.
